_executeAutomationInternal(address).details: 内部执行逻辑，供单个和批量调用复用

batchCheckpoint(uint64,address[]).details: 批量 checkpoint：为多个矿工结算奖励，减少 Gas 费用和交易数量

returns.results: 每个矿工的处理结果（true=成功，false=跳过）

params.amountIn: 要使用的 ETH 数量（wei）
params.fee: V3池子费率（500/2500/10000），V2忽略此参数，传0使用默认费率
params.minOreOut: 最少要收到的 ORI 数量（wei）

checkpoint(uint64,address).details: 在 VRF 结果已知的情况下为指定矿工结算奖励，并把 bot 费用从 checkpoint 池返还。 支持应急退款模式：当 round.totalDeployed == 0 时，全额退还本金 支持过期 checkpoint：过期后仍可调用，但不发放任何奖励（对齐 Solana checkpoint.rs:44-48）

claimAll(address).details: 同时领取所有累计的 ETH 和 ORI 奖励

claimEth(address).details: 领取所有累计的 ETH 奖励

deployManual(uint256,uint256).details: 玩家手动下注：mask 对应 25 个格子，amountPerSquare 为单格投入。

emergencyResetRound(uint64).details: 应急重置机制：当 VRF 长时间未响应时，允许 owner 强制重置并全额退款 对齐 Solana 的无随机数退款机制（reset.rs:87-119, checkpoint.rs:131-143）

executeAutomation(address).details: 单个执行 automation（只有 owner 可以调用）

executeAutomationBatch(address[]).details: 批量执行 automation（只有 owner 可以调用）

getLastRoundWinners().details: 获取上一轮（最近完成的轮次）的中奖信息，无需传入 roundId

returns.participantList: 参与者信息数组（包含地址和下注金额）

getMinerRoundInfo(uint64,address).details: 获取矿工在某轮的完整信息

getMinerSquares(uint64,address).details: 查询指定矿工在某轮下注过的格子与金额。

getRoundData(uint64).details: 获取完整轮次数据（用于脚本和测试）

getSquareParticipants(uint64,uint8).details: 获取指定格子的所有下注参与者信息（地址和金额已在 deploy 时记录）

returns.participantList: 参与者信息数组（包含地址和下注金额）

getTreasuryState().details: 获取 Treasury 完整状态

getUserRewards(address).details: 返回聚合统计：可领取 ETH、未精炼 ORI、精炼 ORI。

getWinningSquareParticipants(uint64).details: 获取指定轮次中奖格子的所有参与者信息（链下可根据此数据计算每个地址的分配份额）

returns.participantList: 参与者信息数组（包含地址和下注金额）

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

proxiableUUID().details: Implementation of the ERC-1822 {proxiableUUID} function. This returns the storage slot used by the implementation. It is used to validate the implementation's compatibility when performing an upgrade. IMPORTANT: A proxy pointing at a proxiable contract should not be considered proxiable itself, because this risks bricking a proxy that upgrades to it, by delegating to itself until out of gas. Thus it is critical that this function revert if invoked through a proxy. This is guaranteed by the `notDelegated` modifier.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

startGame().details: 只能调用一次，部署后管理员需要先配置好所有参数（VRF subscription、前端等）再启动

stopAutomation(address).details: 停用 automation 并取出所有余额

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

upgradeToAndCall(address,bytes).details: Upgrade the implementation of the proxy to `newImplementation`, and subsequently execute the function call encoded in `data`. Calls {_authorizeUpgrade}. Emits an {Upgraded} event.

bury(uint256,uint256,uint24).notice: 通过受信任的路由用 Treasury 的 ETH 回购 ORI：10% 给 staker，90% 立即烧毁

startGame().notice: 启动游戏，创建第一轮并开启投注
